title: 1 Kings 18:30-32 — Elijah repairs the altar with twelve stones
summary: The text of 1 Kings 18:30-32: Elijah calls the people near, repairs the torn-down altar of the LORD, takes twelve stones for the twelve tribes of the sons of Jacob (to whom the LORD said Israel shall be your name), builds an altar in the LORD's name and digs a trench around it large enough for two measures of seed. The names Elijah, LORD and the el in Israel are coloured.

text.text: 30 Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me.” So all the people came near to him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD which had been torn down.
31 Elijah took twelve stones according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
32 So with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD, and he made a trench around the altar, large enough to hold two measures of seed.
